Name: [Performance] Avoid floating point data types
Description: Double causes rounding differences vs. Snowflake reconciliation. Use Decimal (Fixed decimal / Currency) or Int64.

Name: [Performance] No bi-directional relationships
Description: Bi-directional filters create ambiguity and slow models. Use TREATAS or a measure instead.

Name: [Performance] Key columns must not be summarized
Description: Numeric keys should have SummarizeBy = None.

Name: [DAX] Use DIVIDE() instead of the / operator
Description: DIVIDE handles division by zero and returns BLANK.

Name: [DAX] Avoid IFERROR / ISERROR
Description: Error handling functions force cell-by-cell evaluation.

Name: [DAX] Column references must be fully qualified
Description: Write 'Table'[Column], and reference measures without a table name, so readers can tell them apart.

Name: [Governance] Every visible measure needs a description
Description: Descriptions appear as tooltips in the field list and feed the KPI catalogue. Mandatory for certification.

Name: [Governance] Every visible measure needs a display folder
Description: Self-service users find measures by folder (01 Volume, 02 Cost, ...).

Name: [Governance] Numeric measures need a format string
Description: Unformatted numbers are the #1 source of user confusion.
Expression: IsHidden == false and DataType <> DataType.String and string.IsNullOrWhitespace(FormatString) and FormatStringExpression == null

Name: [Governance] Hide foreign keys
Description: Users should slice by dimension attributes, not by fact keys.
Expression: UsedInRelationships.Any(FromColumn.Name == current.Name and FromCardinality == "Many") and IsHidden == false

Name: [Governance] Model must contain a marked date table
Description: Time intelligence requires a contiguous, marked date table.
Expression: not Tables.Any(DataCategory == "Time" and Columns.Any(IsKey == true and DataType == "DateTime"))

Name: [Governance] Visible objects use business names (no underscores / technical prefixes)
Description: Visible names follow the business glossary. Exceptions: the _Measures table.
Expression: IsHidden == false and Name != "_Measures" and (Name.Contains("_") or Name.StartsWith("dim") or Name.StartsWith("fact"))

Name: [Security] PII columns must be protected by object-level security
Description: Columns Email and Hourly Rate must have columnPermission = None in every role except 'HR Full Access'.
Expression: (Name == "Email" or Name == "Hourly Rate") and Model.Roles.Any(Name != "HR Full Access" and current.ObjectLevelSecurity[it] != MetadataPermission.None)

Name: [Security] Certified models must define at least one RLS role
Description: Models without RLS cannot be published to the certified PROD workspace.
